name: NVIDIA SkillSpector
author: NVIDIA

amendments.append: Any scanner that reports incomplete coverage (files skipped, size or file limits hit) is recorded as incomplete, never as clean (AGT-13). NVIDIA SkillSpector is an accepted alternative or second scanner. Install it from a pinned release tag, because it is not on PyPI and a PyPI package of that name is not NVIDIA's. Run it with `--no-llm --fail-on-incomplete`.

notes: Not installed by the scout. The CLI turns LLM review on by default and sends file contents to the configured provider (hosted APIs or agent CLIs), so --no-llm is mandatory under AGT-4. Even with --no-llm the SC4 check sends dependency names and versions to api.osv.dev (public data). --inspect-dependencies downloads npm tarballs. The optional MCP server (`skillspector mcp`) and the bundled skill-inspector skill are not loaded. The skill-inspector skill itself already defaults to --no-llm. 263 of 581 files were not read by the fetch (200-file limit). Owner decision 2026-11-13: Cisco stays the default intake scanner (PyPI-pinned, verified against its tag, no network in the static core). SkillSpector is an alternative until a side-by-side run on the same fixtures, which has not been done yet.
rationale: Distilled as an alternative scanner plus a tool-agnostic coverage rule. A paper comparison with cisco-skill-scanner favours keeping Cisco as the default: it is distributed on PyPI with a verified pin, its static core has no network, and it was reviewed first. SkillSpector adds coverage gates and MCP registry diffing. The incomplete-coverage rule closes a gap in AGT-5 whichever scanner is used.
